what_worked: Slide 4's social-follower null finding contrasted with M&A valuation premium is a genuinely interesting analytical juxtaposition.
fix_next: Replace decorative stock images with actual data charts (scatter plots, histograms) and disclose missingness affecting every denominator.
verdict: Bullet-heavy EDA dump with few real charts, several median errors, and no unifying thesis.
factual_error_detail: Slide 6: AI median $446 vs ref $503; SaaS median $303 vs ref $200.50; Marketing median $1,586 vs ref $2,369.50. Slide 7: Education median $2,141 vs ref $2,435. Slide 6: audience split percentages use full 1000 denominator ignoring 288 missing audience_type. Slide 5: pricing model percentages (~38%+~65%+~22%=125%) sum >100% with no explanation of overlap or sourcing.

evidence.insight: Slide 4 contrasting r=0.022 (followers vs MRR) with r=0.244 (followers vs M&A asking price) is a genuinely decision-useful finding. Slide 7 category volume-vs-median asymmetry is useful. But most slides describe distributions without deeper synthesis or actionable recommendations.
evidence.narrative: Deck proceeds topic-by-topic (MRR, payments, social, pricing, audience, takeaways) without a unifying question or thesis stated upfront. Slide 7 summarizes but doesn't synthesize toward a decision. No purposeful arc or landing beyond restating earlier bullets.
evidence.framing: Title slide says 'Comprehensive Dataset Deep-Dive' but never defines audience, decision context, or key question. No mention of substantial missingness (241 country, 288 audience_type, 274 category) which materially affects denominators used on slides 5 and 6. No scope or limitations section.
evidence.accuracy: Multiple category medians on slide 6 diverge materially from reference values. Audience split percentages ignore 288 missing values. Pricing model percentages on slide 5 sum to >100% without acknowledging overlap. Stripe share 63.6% is consistent with 636/1000. Dodo 5.0% matches 50/1000.
evidence.visual: Only one real data visualization exists (slide 2 horizontal bar chart). Slide 3 uses a decorative fintech stock photo adding zero information. Slide 4 displays r=0.022 as large text but no scatter plot. Slide 5 uses generic icon cards. Repeated teal corner gradient on every slide is template filler. Deck is visually monotonous and text-heavy.
evidence.ai_slop: Slide 3 stock 'FINTECH' image is purely decorative. Consulting-style headers ('Infrastructure Usage & Revenue Correlation', 'Pricing Model Taxonomy & Feature Mechanics') are inflated. Three-card layout on slide 5 is a generic template pattern.
